name: Tempester 1.6.9.1 — pad settings page: each knob under the screen changes the value above it
summary: Everything in 1.6.9.0; on the pad settings page the four knobs under the screen now change the value drawn above them (they were mirrored).

fixes: Pad settings page (Shift + the same pad twice): the left knob under the screen changes the MIDI note, the second the MIDI channel, the third the play probability, the right one the Level, each the value above it.
From 1.6.5.0 to 1.6.9.0 these four knobs were mirrored: the left knob changed the Level, the right one the MIDI note.

description: A correction of 1.6.9.0 admitted on the frozen 1.x line by the author's decision of 20/11/2026 (refs/adr/004-1691-correction.md, amends ADR 003; public issue #3): 1.6.9.0 with n°59 less the four words of its encoder dispatch (patch/pad_settings_1691.json in place of patch/pad_settings.json), n°69 (patch/pad_settings_knob_order.json) and its own version digits (patch/version_1.6.9.1.json in place of patch/version_1.6.9.0.json). On the pad settings page soft knob 1 (leftmost) edits MIDI Note, soft knob 2 MIDI Channel, soft knob 3 Probability, soft knob 4 (rightmost) Level, each the value drawn above it. The image differs from 1.6.9.0 by n°69's four words and the version digits only (tools/line_diff.py --correction); proved in simulation by tools/sim_pad_knobs.py with its counter-proofs, and request 43 answers 1.6.9.1 (verify.sh step 2c). Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged. Installed on 21/11/2026 from the app 0.1.5 (its install record holds this image's hash); tried by hand by the author on the pad settings page: each knob changes the value above it.
